integrity: The proof supplies a normalized covariance certificate, a strict contact inequality, and a determinant-trace global uniqueness argument. No claim of independent audit, external mathematical certification, or priority is made.
scientific_limitations: Exact intrinsic Euclidean outer ellipsoids only, for all integer m >= 2; does not concern inscribed ellipsoids or facet counts. Finite rational tests corroborate but do not establish the universal proof. Equivalence under earlier Lewis-weight book-graph terminology remains a possible literature risk.
title: A sharp Löwner ellipsoid edge-invisibility threshold for book-graph symmetric edge polytopes
